title: Hydrocephalus
summary: HYDROCEPH'ALUS, noun [Gr. water, and the head.] Dropsy of the head; a preternatural distension of the head by a stagnation and extravasation of the lymph, either within or without the cranium.

inlines.v: HYDROCEPH'ALUS, noun [Gr. water, and the head.] Dropsy of the head; a preternatural distension of the head by a stagnation and extravasation of the lymph, either within or without the cranium.
